description.sub_ename: CHINESE-ENGLISH INTERPRETATION OF TRADE AND ECONOMIC TOPICS
description.describe_ch: 此課程除了培養學生對經貿議題的知識之外，並以相關知識為基礎，結合中英口譯技能之訓練，讓學生能掌握主題專業度更高的口譯文本。
description.describe_eh: This course is aimed at not only equipping the students with the knowledge base related to trade and economic topics but also with skills necessary for Chinese-English interpreting tasks. They are expected to work in a more topic-specific and advanced interpreting setting.

targets.describe_ch: 具備口筆譯實務的應用能力
targets.describe_en: To apply the knowledge of translation and interpretation in the workplace

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. Midterm Exam 25%,
2. Final Exam 30%,
3. In-class participation/Assignments/Quizzes/Oral report & Attendance 45%
 
*2 quizzes will be held during the semester. Questions will be taken from handouts and TED Talks Interpretation exercises.
**A volunteer will get 0.45 extra point each time he/she volunteers, with the maximum of a total of 8 points towards the final score per semester.
***Please be punctual. Students who are over 15 minutes late will be considered absent from the class of the day. Moreover, students who are absent for more than 5 (including 5) class meetings (= 10 hours) will fail the course without further notice.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂規則
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. No use of mobile phones unless instructed otherwise. 除非課堂需要及老師允許，上課禁用手機。
4. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks/handouts to class. 請上課攜帶課本/講義，以利上課活動使用。
6. Quizzes and exams can be made up only when you have a valid reason and/or communicate it with the teacher in advance. Valid reasons include documented illness, death in the immediate family, participation in a conference, (car) accidents, etc. The instructor reserves the right to judge whether the absence is valid or not。若您有正當理由請假，或事先與老師溝通提出申請得准予補考測驗/考試。正當理由包括：有證明之疾病、直系親屬死亡、參加會議、車禍意外等等。
7.  Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late applications for make-ups will receive a ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若補考當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
8. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams, and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: Please be punctual. Students who are over 15 minutes late will be considered absent from the class of the day. Moreover, students who are absent for more than 5 (including 5) class meetings (= 10 hours) will fail the course without further notice.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data. AI-generative tools are forbidden to translate assignments unless the instructor permits them for discussion purposes. 學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。除非教師允許為進行討論之用，禁止用AI生成工具/機器翻譯作業。
  2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
  3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
